summary: Ansible bundles six in module_utils so modules can use it without it installed on the target, importing from ansible.module_utils; a newer system six is used if present.
questions: How do I use six in a module without installing it on the target?
Does Ansible use the system six or its bundled copy?

answer_card.title: Bundled six library
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
from ansible.module_utils import six
```
The bundled copy means targets don't need six installed. If the system copy is **newer**, Ansible uses it.
